messages:
Mike N.: Quick async — kicking off tiny canary (slice-B) at 4% for feature/kv-prefetch. Watching latency, 5xx, and token cost. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/internal/canaries/slice-B :eyes:
Alisa P.: seeing small p50 bump in eu-west ~30s after rollout, p95 flat. no 5xx so far. digging into backend traces. :mag:
Priya K.: KV prefetch jobs started ~2m ago, warming rate ~70% for hot keys. won't have full warm until ~10m mark. also increasing cache TTL for slice-B.
ops-bot: Deploy bot: canary deployment slice-B -> 4% complete (run-id: prod-canary-171777). Logs: /logs/prod-canary-171777
Sam G.: pushed a tiny rate-limiter tweak PR that reduces per-user burst by 10% — PR #4321. @Mike N. can you review? It's low risk but may affect p50 spikes.
Mike N.: On it, will review in ~20m. Also if we need to toggle ff quickly, use this curl:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/flags/toggle \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN' \\n  -d '{"flag":"kv-prefetch","state":"off","scope":"slice-B"}'
```
Alisa P.: thanks. I ran a quick trace — increased DB read latency correlates with first prefetch batch. infra pinging DB team. Infra Eng: looking now, might be a brief hotspot on replica-2, shifting some read traffic.
Infra Eng: temporarily rerouting reads off replica-2 for slice-B. monitoring for reduced p50.
Priya K.: if reroute works we can continue warming and hold at 4% until 10m, then consider 20%.
Sam G.: reviewed PR #4321, left one small comment about backoff config. overall looks fine. :thumbsup:
Mike N.: merged PR after Sam's comment. No new 5xx; p50 trending back to baseline in eu-west. plan: hold at 4% for 10m total, then ramp to 20% if stable. I'll post another quick update at ramp decision.
Alisa P.: copy, will watch errors and latency. ping me if you flip the flag.
ops-bot: Incident bot: DB replica-2 alert resolved; severity cleared.
Mike N.: final note — small follow-up: code-review pings for the other rollout change set in #devex, @Sam G. can you queue that?
